locations.note: Nikolai Orelov infiltrates the house where the Romanovs are held in 1918, witnesses their execution and finds that Anastasia survived with the Precursor box.
Nikolai and Anastasia arrive by train as the Red Army retakes Kazan; Trotsky betrays Nikolai to the Templars, and Anastasia frees him before they escape by boat.
Nikolai turns on his own Brotherhood to rescue Anastasia from the Kremlin, destroys an Assassin tank and sends her abroad with a new identity.

routes.name: Nikolai Orelov
routes.note: By train from Yekaterinburg to Kazan, then out of Kazan on a stolen boat and on to Moscow.
